summary: Iteration 41: NFC Activation Page with 3 Modes + Re-encode Feature - All 16 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: NFC Activate page shows 3 mode buttons (bruno, external, link), re-encode section visible with 14 registered tags. All modes work correctly with proper UI elements. NFCRedirectPage correctly redirects registered NFC to card page via navigate().
critical_code_review_comments: ActivateNFCPage.jsx correctly implements 3 NFC activation modes with data-testid attributes
Mode 1 (Bruno): Shows ID input field (bruno-nfc-id-input) and card selector with bruno-activate-btn
Mode 2 (External): Shows NFC compatibility notice and external-nfc-write-btn button
Mode 3 (Link): Shows card selector and generate-link-btn, displays generated link with copy button
Re-encode section visible when user has existing NFC tags with nfc-reencode-btn
Back button in header correctly navigates from mode to mode selector
GET /api/nfc/my-cards returns redirect_url and card_title for each NFC card
GET /api/nfc/go/{nfcId} returns HTTP 302 redirect for registered NFC to /c/{cardId}
GET /api/nfc/go/{fake_id} returns HTTP 302 redirect to /n/{fake_id} for unregistered
POST /api/nfc/activate works with card_id and creates NFC registration
GET /api/nfc/resolve/{nfcId} returns found:true with card_id for registered NFC
NFCRedirectPage (/n/{nfcId}) uses navigate() instead of window.location.href for instant redirect
Generated NFC links use correct format: {domain}/api/nfc/go/{nfcId}
Web NFC API check correctly shows 'NFC no disponible' warning in headless browser
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 41 verified NFC activation page with 3 modes and re-encode feature.
